name: stringfromint1.k
model:
class StringFromInt1 {
  numStr1:String
  numVal1:Int

  req numStr1 = "42"

  req numVal1 = numStr1.toInt()

  req numVal1 = 42
  numStr2:String
  numVal2:Int

  req numStr2 = "12345"

  req numVal2 = numStr2.toInt()

  req numVal2 = 12345
  numStr3:String
  numVal3:Int

  req numStr3 = "0"

  req numVal3 = numStr3.toInt()

  req numVal3 = 0
}

main:StringFromInt1

; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringFromInt1 (mk-StringFromInt1 (numStr1 String)(numVal1 Int)(numStr2 String)(numVal2 Int)(numStr3 String)(numVal3 Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringFromInt1 (sel-StringFromInt1 StringFromInt1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringFromInt1 ((this Ref)) Bool

)

(define-fun deref-StringFromInt1 ((this Ref)) StringFromInt1
  (sel-StringFromInt1 (deref this))
)

; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store

  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
